priority_items.summary: WTPQ32 PGUM 151508 Advisory Number 5 (LM 15:08:27 GMT; 108 AM ChST Fri 16 Oct) upgrades Champi to a tropical storm at 40 mph, 11.1N 156.8E, about 825 miles east of Guam. Typhoon Watch remains for Guam, Rota, Tinian and Saipan. Forecast: possibly a typhoon Saturday; close to Guam Sunday morning. Next intermediate 500 AM ChST / next scheduled 800 AM ChST. Advertised 200 AM / 16:00 UTC full advisory dropped 52 minutes early. Leftover JTWC Warning NR 005 (WTPN32 PGTW 151500; LM still 13:42:12 GMT) still tropical storm 035 kt at 11.0N 157.4E; no NR 006; next still 152100Z. This-window ABPW 151500 (LM 15:00:16 GMT) upgrades the 29W paragraph to tropical storm. Leftover HLS 151056 LM still 10:56:40 GMT still prints depression. CAP recapture still 8:56 PM ChST Watch Update (VTEC O.CON). TCV still none. This-scan recapture of 1225 AM ChST marine O.CON (origin 14:25 UTC) already names Tropical Storm Champi. JTWC 60-hr 090 kt at 13.5N 144.5E remains forecast closest-approach near Guam, not a verifying landfall. Not Category now. Not FLASH.
